'''Morn''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[King of Mon Cala/Legends|king]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].<ref name="Strongholds" /> Around [[4500 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'' states that [[King of Mon Cala/Legends|King]] Morn united the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] four and a half [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which corresponds to approximately [[4500 BBY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> he became the first ruler of Dac to unite the Mon Calamari and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Species/Legends|people]] under the rule of a single [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Morn was mentioned in ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', a [[2015]] sourcebook of [[Fantasy Flight Games]]'s [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
